description: MIG-003 V2 (Prompt 4, Phase 10): independent re-implementation of parser:chat.complete:claude-sse v1. Same row grammar, same refusal law — different machine: decode-then-fold (pure event list + slot-map join) instead of V1's online tail-mutation loop. Shares NO code with V1 (row shapes re-declared; the differential test, not shared code, is the contract). NOT routable.

parser.doc: parser:chat.complete:claude-sse v2 — same pin surface as v1 (composition membership selects). Single-pass decode into typed events, then an explicit-state fold (OPEN/APPEND/CLOSE) over a slot map. Byte-identical rows to v1 on all in-domain inputs (proven by the differential suite); identical refusal law.
